name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam O'Connell's journey into motorsport was anything but conventional. Starting as a mechanic in his family's auto repair shop in County Cork, Liam developed a keen eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving. He honed his skills on local rally cars before landing a spot with a small Formula Ford team. Over the years, Liam's dedication and relentless pursuit of improvement saw him rise through the ranks, taking on increasingly challenging roles, including several stints as a race engineer and team manager. He joined AF Corse five years ago. 

As Head of Operations, Liam is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing sight of the big picture. He champions a collaborative environment, believing that open communication and mutual respect are essential for success. Liam's pragmatic approach, combined with a touch of Irish charm, makes him a highly respected figure within the team. His distinctive approach is his focus on preventative maintenance, a key part of his operations plan.

physical.description: Liam is a stout man with a weathered face and kind eyes that belie his years of experience in the high-pressure world of motorsport.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn wrench in his pocket.
Has a habit of whistling Irish folk tunes when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong tea before every race.
